sql: SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status
SELECT id, title, status, desk FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23'
SELECT id, article, kind, text FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7]
SELECT id, title, status, body FROM article WHERE body CONTAINS 'kill' OR body CONTAINS 'pulled' OR body CONTAINS 'retract'
SELECT id, parent, content FROM passage WHERE content CONTAINS 'kill' OR content CONTAINS 'pull' OR content CONTAINS 'retract' OR content CONTAINS 'spike'
SELECT id, article, kind, text FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull' OR text CONTAINS 'retract' OR text CONTAINS 'spike' OR text CONTAINS 'withdraw'
SELECT id, heading, body FROM factbox WHERE body CONTAINS 'kill' OR body CONTAINS 'pull' OR body CONTAINS 'retract' OR body CONTAINS 'spike' OR body CONTAINS 'withdraw' OR heading CONTAINS 'kill'
SELECT id, title, status, published_at FROM article ORDER BY status
SELECT id, status, ->covers->topic.name AS topics FROM article WHERE status != 'c_04'
SELECT id, status, title, desk, body FROM article WHERE id = article:a33 OR id = article:a19 OR id = article:a7 OR id = article:a12
